Alright! The special annual martial arts\ncompetition is here again!! You've been looking\nforward to it too, haven't you?!

You finally understand!! This is the only place\nyou can burn away the fire in your heart!\nGet fired up and let it burn!!
I won't force you then...My fire doesn't burn hot\naround someone with no desire to fight!!\nWhat a worthless adventurer!!
